_comment: Advisory trigger evals — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. Should-trigger: establishing a brand's identity, guidelines, palette, typography, voice or positioning from its own site and creative. Should-not-trigger: a single product's facts (analyzing-products), auditing the user's own running ads (analyzing-own-ads), competitor research (researching-competitor-ads), deciding what to make next (planning-campaigns), generating creative, and an off-topic control. Facts only — nothing generated or judged.
